objective: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

description: The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands bring great pain to me.  Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.
Through you I can deliver my own message of pain.  Go forth and deliver my wrath.
progress: The shadowsworn are not easily defeated, are they? But you are a warrior, and you will triumph or perish trying.
completion: Already you have subdued my pain and honored me.  Thank you, warrior.
